changes.schedule: One Saturday a month, 9:00 am, March to October (the host may add a November ride if the weather allows); a different coffee shop each month, posted on FAB's calendar
changes.pace: casual, social; nobody gets left behind
changes.description: A monthly Saturday morning ride put on by Falls Area Bicyclists, the local bike advocacy group. Each month it starts and ends at a different coffee shop in town, about 10 easy miles on low-stress streets. Check the FAB calendar for that month's spot; e-bikes are welcome.

refresh.notes: The ride is on FAB's "Rides & Events" Google Calendar, not on the Wild Apricot events list (fallsareabicyclists.org/events shows "No events available" and never carried it). The htmlembed agenda shows the current month; add &dates=YYYYMMDD/YYYYMMDD to read another. Each month's entry gives that month's coffee shop.
